contracts.planner: buildCriterionReport consumes a current canonical checklist and original existing quality lease, keeping task fingerprint and criterion fingerprint separate. Every applicable criterion receives pending/blocked/eligible-explicit state; complete always false. Explicit decisions bind current listing/category/family/criterion/revision/requirement digest/release and exact evidence kind. HTTP200 or a passed harness is not a decision.
contracts.proof_gates: Source and visual criteria require explicit manual review. Owner/category journeys require actual owner authority and owner journey attestation. Functional/family operations require every required action/provider state; missing declarations refuse. Evidence older than7days refuses. Existing source holds and visibility remain blockers.
contracts.artifact_gate: Exact numeric immutable HTTPS GitHub Actions run/artifact URI plus archive SHA and1–12 entry path/SHA/kind pins. Local ZIP bytes and each declared entry extracted from that same archive are hashed, compared with retained entry files, bounded and checked for path escape. A sha256 URI or unrelated sidecar alone cannot qualify.
contracts.trusted_service_boundary: Explicit approved stage+actor+decision/requirement digest is mandatory; existing canonical service-only RPC ACL remains final authority. This module does not authenticate a human reviewer or prove remote Actions artifact existence. Future root-owned upload/admission must verify actual publication and actor authority before invoking it; no production artifact has been uploaded by this packet.
contracts.specialist: prepareCriterionRequest rebuilds deterministic report before preparing payload. recordCriterion reads current checklist, persists immutable original UUID+complete exact request before canonical criterion RPC, rereads current checklist/latest receipt ID/stage/actor/commit/status after it. Canonical original task lease must still be live; finish-first test refuses.
contracts.reviewer: Exact current passed specialist ID, distinct actor, same release and new independent archive digest required. Canonical writer enforces7day/current revision/fingerprint and specialist supersession. Same harness rerun alone does not establish manual review.
contracts.uncertainty: Lost writer response or unconfirmed current receipt stores sanitized uncertainty and stops. Same UUID/payload only under explicit resume; changed UUID blocked while another pending request in the same stable directory is unresolved. A canonical historical replay never becomes a current claim without current fingerprint/revision/latest-ID recheck. Caller must preserve one stable request directory; choosing a fresh directory is not an authorized recovery.
contracts.stage_collector: New opt-in --stage-criteria requires release SHA before acquiring any fresh lease, reads current checklist, stages percriterion plan with no explicit automatic passes, writes pending stage marker, then stops BEFORE task_finish. Removing the flag on --resume cannot bypass the persisted marker. Ordinary lease expiry remains unchanged. Legacy default/manual behavior unchanged and automatic request stays disabled/expired.
contracts.separate_states: Aggregate task finish, criterion specialist evidence, independently current signoff, client-brief draft and complete operational home are separate. No approved machine brief state or category completion is invented.
